subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select ‘No substitution’.

This case is serious. You need to __look into__ this matter; otherwise, the situation will get out of control soon.
solution:
The correct answer is Option 3 i.e. **No substitution.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The original phrase "look into" perfectly captures the required action in the context of the given sentence.
 
• **"Look into" **is used when someone **needs to investigate or examine something thoroughly**, which aligns with the seriousness of the case mentioned. (जाँच करना)

Therefore, the complete sentence is- *This case is serious. You need to **look into__** this matter; otherwise, the situation will get out of control soon. *

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **"look up":** means to search for information, usually in a book or online. It does not convey the sense of investigating a serious matter. (खोज करना)
 
• **"look at":** This means to direct one's gaze towards something. It lacks the implication of investigating or analyzing a situation deeply. (देखना)
 
• **"look after": **This phrase means to take care of someone or something and is not appropriate for the context of dealing with a case or situation through investigation. ( देखभाल करना)
